text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows significant hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low total protein, with abnormal white cell differential (low neutrophil and lymphocyte percentages, elevated monocytes and basophils). Erythrocyte distribution width is increased. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or systemic illness; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended. Other parameters are within normal limits.
